summary.zh: 用补偿事务实现跨服务分布式流程
summary.en: Coordinate distributed transactions with compensating actions

description.zh: 为跨微服务的业务流程设计 Saga 编排，在库存、支付、物流等服务之间安排补偿与回滚步骤，并处理长期卡住的事务状态。适合无法使用两阶段提交、又需要最终一致性的场景。落地时需要结合具体的服务与消息中间件。
description.en: Design saga coordinators for multi-service workflows, with compensating steps across inventory, payment, and shipping plus recovery for stuck transactions. Use it when two-phase commit is unavailable and eventual consistency is needed.
